details: The pointermove handler calls showCrosshair() unthrottled on every event, mutating 48 DOM attributes (12 crosshair lines + 36 dots) per frame with no requestAnimationFrame coalescing or dirty-flag pattern. All other checks pass: pointer events API avoids mouse/touch double-firing, there are no D3 transitions in the interaction path so no mid-flight snap risk, xScale/yScale are stable closures with no zoom or resize, and there is no cross-view dispatch that could cause feedback loops.
